appDescription.message: Sort tabs by task, purpose or site from a side panel, lock groups, reopen closed groups and search every tab.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search tabs by title or URL…

searchHint.message: ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to open, Esc to clear

newGroupPlaceholder.message: Group name (leave blank to name it for you)

closeDuplicatesTitle.message: Close tabs that show the same page as another tab, keeping one of each

groupSeriesTitle.message: Put every ungrouped tab into one new group and name it for you

addToCurrentTitle.message: Add the ungrouped tabs to the group you are working in

saveGroupTitle.message: Keep this group's name, color and tabs so you can reopen it later, also on your other computers

savedLocalOnlyTitle.message: Too large to sync, so it is kept on this device only

openSavedTitle.message: Reopen as a new group in this window

openSavedFailed.message: Couldn't open any of these tabs

reclassifyTitle.message: Sort every unlocked group and ungrouped tab again

modeProjectDesc.message: AI finds tabs that belong to the same task, even across sites. Without AI, tabs opened together stay together.

modeCategoryDesc.message: Development, design, docs, AI, video, social, shopping, news…

modeRecencyDesc.message: Today, this week and older, to find tabs you can close

reclassifyNothing.message: Nothing to sort: no tabs fit together

projectNoAi.message: AI isn’t available right now, so tabs were grouped by when they were opened

lockTitle.message: Reclassify won’t touch a locked group

lockNeedsName.message: Name the group to lock it

keepGroupTitle.message: Move to Saved, so it isn’t cleared with old closed groups

optAiNamingDesc.message: Names new groups and sorts tabs by task with the AI model built into Chrome, which runs on this computer, when it is already installed. Otherwise groups are named after the date, and tabs opened together stay together.

optRememberClosedDesc.message: Keeps the last 20 groups you close under Recently closed, so you can reopen them.

optCloudAi.message: Use Groupify’s cloud AI when on-device AI isn’t available

optCloudAiDesc.message: Sends the titles and site names of the tabs being grouped (never full addresses) to Groupify’s server on Cloudflare, which asks an AI model and keeps nothing. Free, shared by everyone, with a daily limit: when it runs out, groups are named after the date.

projectNoAiHint.message: No AI available, so tabs were grouped by when they were opened. You can turn on cloud AI in Settings.

optAutoSave.message: Changes are saved right away and follow you to other computers through Chrome sync.

optDownloadModelDesc.message: Chrome downloads its AI model once (several gigabytes, on an unmetered connection). After that, names are made on this computer.

optDownloadFailed.message: The download didn’t start. Check that there is enough free space and try again.

optCloudAiHint.message: This computer has no on-device AI, so groups are named after the date unless you turn this on.

optLockedNone.message: None yet. Lock a group from its menu in the side panel.

optShortcutNone.message: No shortcut is set. You can add one.

historyHint.message: Changes made in this window, kept until you close the browser

historyEmpty.message: Nothing yet. Every change Groupify makes to your groups is saved here, so you can go back more than one step.

restoreTitle.message: Put every group back the way it was before this change. Tabs opened later stay ungrouped.

ungroupAllTitle.message: Remove every group in this window. Tabs stay open, and History can bring the groups back.

modeTidyDesc.message: Ungrouped tabs join the group they belong to (your remembered sites, then the same site). Nothing else moves.

tidyNothing.message: No new tab belongs to an existing group yet

optAutoLock.message: Lock groups I make or change myself

optAutoLockDesc.message: A group you name, rename or drag a tab into is locked, so Reclassify leaves it alone. This includes changes in Chrome’s tab bar.

optRulesDesc.message: When you put a tab into a named group yourself, its site is remembered there. Reclassify and Only tidy new tabs then put that site back in that group, whatever the method.

optRulesNone.message: None yet. Drag a tab into a group, or name a group yourself.
